why: Two things, and the declaration named only the first: (a) one observation recorded into docs/claude/OPEN-ITEMS.json -- the session-end duty CLAUDE.md names -- written as a line-level edit (2 lines changed, file re-parsed after) because the register is hand-formatted at indent=1 and NO json.dumps configuration reproduces it byte-for-byte, so a read-modify-write would have reformatted all 1855 lines; and (b) the generated CLAUDE.md SESSION-BRIEF block, re-rendered with scripts/ops/render_session_brief.py --write because changing the registers makes it stale and session-brief-guard correctly refuses that. A brief RE-RENDER is on the manager surface; editing CLAUDE.md prose is not, and none is edited here. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no tests/, no scripts/, no workflow, no order path. Nothing is cleared or deleted: the OPEN-ITEMS row is left in place with its clears_when marked MET so the evidence is reviewable before an irreversible removal.
